method.renderer: Actual FightEngine.update/render with @napi-rs/canvas; ordinary duel descriptors and natural intros.
method.inputs: Synthetic keydown/keyup events delivered only to the original registered InputState callbacks. Bindings read from engine.bindings.
method.scheduling: Manual logical update ticks; engine.frame and actor clocks are never assigned. Native rendering receives the current tick time.
method.decoder: Exact local PNG bytes verified against manifest; memory-only sharp PNG normalization with full decoded RGBA equality.
method.environment: Minimal window/document/storage/event/gamepad adapters; requestAnimationFrame does not schedule a browser loop.

limits: No Chromium, browser DOM/CSS, HTTP delivery, physical keyboard, service worker or offline behavior is tested.
One static attack image is not an animated clip; source timing and fidelity 1:1 remain unverified.
Opposite orientation uses the existing engine mirror, not a separately sourced view.
This is rendering, input route, natural recovery and stage composition QA; not a complete damage, guard, collision or finisher matrix.
The revised initial collision position and one-time emission sweep are versus adaptations measured from candidate PNGs.
